segments.text:
The Change of Providences is never nearer
to the people of God, than when their hearts
are lifted up, or grown secure by prosperity.
Doth HezekJah glory in his Treasures? The
next news he hears, is of an impoverishing Providence
at hand, Isa. 39. 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7. Others
may be left to perish in unsanctified Prosperity,
but you shall not.
